description:
Confession is something that is given. The right to blame the other person, the right to demand an apology, the right to apologize for doing something wrong, the right to be dumped and dumped. However, I, we have not obtained such rights… … . In early summer, while washing lettuce at the garden faucet, Lee Soo-wan meets Seo Jin-ha’s eyes. Soo-wan, who has been suffering from housework for several days because of a special guest invited by her grandmother, does not look kindly at him. She thought that if she endured this one time, she would never see him again, but something strange happened. He visits the house every day and stamps his face. She easily persuades her grandmother, who is obsessed with healthy food, to order delivery food and free her from housework. Soo-wan gradually begins to anticipate Jin-ha’s visit and becomes conscious of him. That winter, when Su-wan ran away from home because she couldn't stand the bullying of her grandmother and her stepbrother who hated her mother, Jin-ha appears in front of her. He gives her warm food and a gift-like message. "Let's tutor. I'll make you my junior." The secret tutoring started cautiously. Her initial determination to enter S University and flatten her stepbrother's nose gradually grew bigger than her longing to see him. She thought Jin-ha felt the same way. Now all that was left was her confession, and everything was beautiful. Until she heard a shocking confession from her best friend... ... .
